summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, reporting that it cancelled its previously scheduled Annual General Meeting (AGM) originally set for July 9, 2026. The cancellation is to revise Proposal 5 concerning the company's Amended and Restated Compensation Policy, following discussions with certain shareholders and their feedback. The company will promptly file a new Form 6-K announcing a revised AGM with updated proxy materials. This is a routine procedural adjustment to a shareholder meeting agenda, not a special situation event.
